decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher is close to the core Multigraf line, keeps its own product page, and costs little to carry as a distributor offering, so there is no reason to withdraw it.

The public German premiere and flagship positioning in the embellishment direction create strong visible commitment, especially after the other flagship (D) was withdrawn, so management will persist and attribute slow uptake to market timing.
The sheet preparation module complements the modular finishing systems, so removing it would weaken the integrated offer for little gain.
The hybrid saddle stitcher sits in the firm's booklet-making core and supports the move toward automated, digitally oriented workflows.
The folding add-on has a documented customer installation alongside the core creasing system, so it shows positive results and fits closely with the established portfolio.
